+"""RoboTwin 2.0 stack_blocks_three control record.
+
+This is the client-side manipulation plan used for the live, single-episode run.
+The episode itself is not reset or replayed by this file.  Object coordinates
+were estimated from the calibrated head RGB/depth camera; all commanded poses
+are RoboTwin EE frames (the TCP is 0.12 m forward along local +x).
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import sys
+import numpy as np
+
+sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+
+Q_SIDE = np.array([0.7, 0.0, 0.0, 0.714142])   # horizontal approach toward +y
+Q_DOWN = np.array([0.5, -0.5, 0.5, 0.5])      # local +x points down
+
+
+def measured(robot: Robot) -> np.ndarray:
+    """Return the latest 82-column proprioception vector."""
+    return np.asarray(robot.get_obs(video="none").meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=float)
+
+
+def command_pose(robot: Robot, left, left_grip, right, right_grip, note=""):
+    """Submit one dual-arm EE pose row; each pose is xyz + wxyz."""
+    row = np.r_[left, left_grip, right, right_grip].astype(np.float32)
+    return robot.submit("ee_pose", row, note=note)
+
+
+def hold_other_arm(now: np.ndarray, arm: str):
+    """Return a measured pose row for the arm that is not being moved."""
+    if arm == "left":
+        return now[21:28].copy()
+    return now[14:21].copy()
+
+
+def calibrated_block_centers(robot: Robot):
+    """Estimate colored block centers from head RGB/depth and camera calibration."""
+    obs = robot.get_obs(cameras=("head_camera",), include_depth=True, video="none")
+    rgb = obs.last["head_camera"].astype(float)
+    depth = obs.depth["head_camera"][0].astype(float) * 0.001  # service depth is mm
+    red, green, blue = rgb.transpose(2, 0, 1)
+    masks = {
+        "red": (red > 90) & (red > 1.3 * green) & (red > 1.3 * blue),
+        "green": (green > 55) & (green > 1.2 * red) & (green > blue),
+        "blue": (blue > 65) & (blue > 1.05 * red) & (blue > green),
+    }
+    cam = obs.meta["cameras"]["head_camera"]
+    K = np.asarray(cam["intrinsic_cv"], dtype=float)
+    E = np.asarray(cam["extrinsic_cv"], dtype=float)
+    Rcw, t = E[:3, :3], E[:3, 3]
+    centers = {}
+    for color, mask in masks.items():
+        ys, xs = np.where(mask)
+        if not len(xs):
+            continue
+        d = depth[ys, xs]
+        valid = (d > 0.1) & (d < 2.0)
+        if not np.any(valid):
+            continue
+        x, y, d = xs[valid], ys[valid], d[valid]
+        xyz_cam = np.stack(((x - K[0, 2]) * d / K[0, 0],
+                            (y - K[1, 2]) * d / K[1, 1], d), axis=1)
+        xyz_world = (xyz_cam - t) @ Rcw
+        centers[color] = np.median(xyz_world, axis=0)
+    return centers
+
+
+# Safe pose waypoints used during the episode.  The live trajectory includes
+# visual corrections after blocks shifted; the coordinates below record the
+# calibrated initial positions and intended stack point.
+INITIAL_BLOCKS = {
+    "red":   np.array([ 0.231, -0.018, 0.765]),
+    "green": np.array([-0.229, -0.009, 0.765]),
+    "blue":  np.array([-0.135, -0.044, 0.765]),
+}
+STACK_XY = np.array([0.0, 0.0])
+BLOCK_HEIGHT = 0.05
+
+
+def ee_for_tcp(xyz, q, tcp_xyz):
+    """Convert a desired TCP point to its EE-frame position."""
+    # For the horizontal Q_SIDE pose, TCP = EE + [0, .12, 0].
+    # For Q_DOWN, TCP = EE + [0, 0, -.12].
+    q = np.asarray(q, dtype=float)
+    if np.allclose(q, Q_SIDE, atol=0.02):
+        offset = np.array([0.0, 0.12, 0.0])
+    else:
+        offset = np.array([0.0, 0.0, -0.12])
+    return np.asarray(tcp_xyz, dtype=float) - offset
+
+

+    print("the episode is single-use and this script does not reset or replay it.")
*** End Patch";
